commands.review_summary:
This PR updates iMessage poll-vote capability gating, inbound poll rendering, cross-run poll-vote echo suppression, and monitor handling for poll comments, with focused tests.

PR surface: Source +131, Tests +97. Total +228 across 11 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: after a poll is remembered, any inbound message with a matching reply_to_id enters the new poll-comment branch and returns before dispatch. I did not run a live iMessage repro in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - A human should decide or author the imsg-specific caption discriminator; automation should not guess which reply_to_id payloads are safe to drop.

target.title: fix(imessage): make native poll voting work end-to-end
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Native iMessage poll **voting** was broken end-to-end on `main`. When a user sent
the agent a poll, the agent replied with a prose text ("🦞 I'd pick Orange."),
often repeatedly, instead of casting a vote — and when it did vote, it also sent a
redundant text restating its choice. Confirmed live on macOS 26 against the Codex
rollout: the model was calling `message action=reply` with text, not `poll-vote`.

Four independent defects combined to cause this:

1. **Phantom capability gate.** Discovery (`message-tool-api.ts`) and execution
   (`actions.ts`) gated `poll-vote` on a `pollVoteMessage` selector that **imsg
   never emits** — a grep of the entire imsg source and git history shows only
   `pollPayloadMessage` exists. Once the private-API probe cache warmed,
   `!pollVoteMessage` was always true, so `poll-vote` was stripped from the tool
   schema and the model fell back to a prose reply.
2. **No vote cue in the render.** The inbound poll rendered as a flat
   `[poll shared] — options: …` notification, giving the model no reason to vote.
3. **Instance-scoped echo guard.** A poll and its comment arrive as two separate
   inbound messages processed in two separate agent runs (fresh tool instance
   each). The `poll_vote_echo` record lived in an instance-local variable, so it
   was gone by the follow-up run and the restatement leaked.
4. **Poll comment delivered standalone.** iMessage attaches a poll's comment as an
   inline reply to the poll balloon. It reached the agent as its own message, so
   the agent answered it in prose in addition to voting.

## Why This Change Was Made

1. Gate `poll-vote` on the **real** `pollPayloadMessage` selector (votes use the
   same balloon initializer as poll-send) plus the advertised `poll.vote` rpc
   method — both of which imsg actually reports. This keeps the ship-ahead safety
   (voting stays hidden on imsg builds without `poll.vote`) without the phantom.
2. Render the poll as `📊 Poll: … Cast your vote with the poll-vote action
   (pollOptionIndex = the option number); do not answer in a text reply.` — an
   explicit call-to-action, safe now that the echo guard drops any spoken answer.
   The `📊 Poll:` prefix also matches the trigger phrasing agents key vote
   instructions on.
3. Move the echo record to a **session-scoped**, route-checked, TTL-bounded map so
   the vote in one run suppresses the restatement in the next, never crossing
   conversations.
4. Track recent poll balloons in the monitor and **fold** (drop) a later inline
   reply to them; the poll message already carries the options + vote cue, so the
   agent votes once and has nothing standalone to answer.

(The emoji-anywhere echo normalizer already landed on `main` as
`poll-vote-echo.ts`; this change builds on it and does not touch it.)

## User Impact

- Sending the agent an iMessage poll now results in a **single clean vote** — no
  prose reply, no repeated messages, no redundant restatement, no reply to the
  poll's comment.
- Voting stays correctly hidden on imsg builds that don't advertise `poll.vote`.
- No config or API surface change.

## Evidence

- `extensions/imessage/src/actions.test.ts` — 49 passed (gate).
- `extensions/imessage/src/message-tool-api.test.ts` — passed (discovery gate,
  incl. "offers poll-vote when pollPayloadMessage + poll.vote rpc are present").
- `src/agents/tools/message-tool.test.ts` "poll vote echo guard" — 14 passed,
  incl. new cross-run (separate tool instance, same session) and
  cross-conversation isolation cases, coexisting with main's keycap test.
- `extensions/imessage/src/monitor/poll-render.test.ts`,
  `extensions/imessage/src/monitor/poll-comment.test.ts` — passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` + `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — clean; oxlint clean.
- **Live, macOS 26.4.1, fresh imsg dev build injected:** end-to-end through the
  running gateway. Before: agent replied "🦞 I'd pick Orange." (no vote), often
  repeated. After each fix landed, and finally together: a real `associated_message_type=4000`
  vote on the poll and **zero** outbound text (verified in `chat.db`: `votes=1,
  text=0`). The poll's comment (an inline reply to the balloon) is folded and not
  answered.
